subject: a Chinese scholar of the 5th century BC with a long dark beard and hair tied in a topknot under a simple cloth cap, wearing wide-sleeved layered hemp robes with a sash, calm and kind face

panels.01-lu: a small walled town in the ancient Chinese state of Lu around 551 BC, rammed-earth walls, wooden houses with thatched and tiled roofs, millet fields and a winding river, morning mist, wide establishing shot, Zhou dynasty period
panels.02-learning: a fifteen-year-old Chinese boy in a plain hemp robe kneeling on a mat, reading bamboo slip scrolls by the light of a small oil lamp in a poor house, ancient China 6th century BC, quiet determination
panels.03-teacher: {S} seated on a mat under an old apricot tree, teaching a circle of young students of different ages kneeling with bamboo scrolls, warm afternoon light, ancient China around 520 BC, respectful and lively discussion
panels.04-minister: {S} in formal official robes standing in a wooden hall of the Lu court, advising a seated duke while officials listen, bronze ritual vessels on stands, ancient China around 500 BC, dignified
panels.05-road: {S} riding in a simple wooden ox cart with a few students walking beside it on a dusty road leaving a walled town, distant hills, ancient China around 497 BC, a long journey begins
panels.06-chen: {S} sitting calmly and speaking to his followers in a bare camp while weary students rest on the ground around him, empty grain baskets, dusk, ancient China, hardship borne with dignity
panels.07-return: an older {S} with a grey beard at a low desk surrounded by bundles of bamboo slip books, carefully arranging and editing them, students copying beside him, ancient China around 484 BC
panels.08-temple: a simple old house in Qufu turned into a shrine with incense smoke rising, students in robes bowing respectfully before it, a young cypress tree in the courtyard, ancient China, timeless and peaceful
